map.车位利用率怎么算？: How Do You Compute Space Utilization?
map.出租固定位除以总固定位，结合临停周转；长期空置位应调价或转共享。: Rented fixed spaces divided by total fixed spaces, combined with temporary-parking turnover; long-vacant spaces should be repriced or converted to shared use.
map.收费和系统对不上先查什么？: What Do I Check First When Revenue and the System Disagree?
map.先查免费放行权限、手动抬杆记录与包月到期未续，这三处最易漏收。: Check free-exit permissions, manual barrier-open records, and monthly passes that expired without renewal — these three leak the most revenue.
